content.thinking: My mk() helper uses kw keys as strings; `g[off:off+len(val)]` fails because off is a string. Let me rewrite the test more plainly.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, json, struct, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'project')
from wire import packet, payload, seal
K,D,N=4,2,4
base=packet(0,0,payload(0,0,0,D))
def reseal(g):
    g=bytearray(g); g[24:26]=b'\x00\x00'
    tot=sum(struct.unpack('!10H',bytes(g[14:34])))
    while tot>>16: tot=(tot&65535)+(tot>>16)
    g[24:26]=struct.pack('!H',(~tot)&65535)
    return seal(bytes(g[:-4])+b'\0'*4)
def mk(pairs):
    g=bytearray(base)
    for off,val in pairs: g[off:off+len(val)]=val
    return reseal(bytes(g))
tests=[]
def t(name,frame,expect,rank=0): tests.append((name,frame,rank,expect))
t('flags MF', mk([(20,b'\x20\x00')]),'wire')
t('frag offset', mk([(21,b'\x01')]),'wire')
t('flags 0000', mk([(20,b'\x00\x00')]),'data')
t('bad src ip', mk([(26,b'\x0a\x00\x00\x09')]),'endpoint')
t('bad dst ip', mk([(30,b'\x0a\x00\x00\x66')]),'endpoint')
t('dst mac = host', mk([(0,b'\x02\x00\x00\x00\x00\x01')]),'endpoint')
t('endpoint bad + icrc bad', bytes(bytearray(mk([(0,b'\x02\x00\x00\x00\x00\x01')]))[:-1]+b'\x00'),'wire')
t('psn K-1', packet(0,K-1,payload(0,0,0,D)),'data')
t('psn K', packet(0,K,payload(0,0,0,D)),'endpoint')
t('psn huge', packet(0,0x123456,payload(0,0,0,D)),'endpoint')
t('ack valid', packet(0,5,ack=True),'ack')
t('ack wrong aeth', reseal(bytearray(packet(0,5,ack=True))[:54]+b'\x1f\x00\x00\x09'+bytearray(packet(0,5,ack=True))[58:]),'wire')
t('short frame', base[:40],'wire')
t('empty frame', b'','wire')
t('wrong port rank (frame from host0 on port1)', base,'endpoint',1)
ev=[{'op':'wire','rank':r,'hex':f.hex()} for _,f,r,_ in tests]
case={'primitive':'allreduce','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':K,'words':D,'capacity':N,'start':0,'events':ev,'trace':0}
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','project/solver.py'],input=json.dumps({'cases':[case]}).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,cwd='/workspace')
st=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())['cases'][0]['state']
got={'wire':st[26],'endpoint':st[27],'data':st[18],'ack':st[19]}
exp={'wire':0,'endpoint':0,'data':0,'ack':0}
for _,_,_,e in tests: exp[e]+=1
print('got',got); print('exp',exp); print('MATCH' if got==exp else 'DIFF')
# cross-check reference model too
sys.path.insert(0,'dev'); import ref
out=ref.solve({'cases':[case]})['cases'][0]['state']
print('ref', {'wire':out[26],'endpoint':out[27],'data':out[18],'ack':out[19]})
EOF
